name: @repo/morph-surface
description: Feedback dock that morphs from a compact pill into a panel and back, with a spring layout transition.

useCases: Compact feedback dock that expands into a form
Floating action pill that morphs into a panel
Any control that should grow in place rather than open a modal
compositionHints: Grows in place, so keep it out of tight layouts that would clip the panel
For an actual AI composer use ai-prompt-input instead
Escape closes the panel; Cmd+Enter submits
